title: Exploring the Impact of Training Data Distribution and Subword Tokenization on Gender Bias in Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the translation accuracy (F1 score) of gender-inflected profession names using the WinoMT dataset, specifically measuring the difference in performance between masculine and feminine entities (ΔG) as well as between pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical gender role assignments (ΔS).
